base_document.input: Masked board and public origin/move/approach/retreat history only.
base_document.prediction: Conditional feature likelihood product; no online access to labels. Rank prior supplied by exact remaining inventory.

recipe: DOS-only training views; moved concealed enemy ranks only; game-view weights; categorical alpha10 smoothing. Frozen old weights unchanged.

provenance.scope: Historical development only. Never campaign validation or fresh outcomes.
provenance.observer_filter: Only own side opposite msdos-1990-v2-normal; fit labels only moved concealed enemy mobile ranks.
provenance.fitting: Train partition only; each piece weighted by inverse number of views of its game; rank-conditional categorical tables; alpha=10 pooled-frequency smoothing.
provenance.calibration_selection: Same old whole-pair calibration partition; choose feature group and strength by game-weighted approximate fractional moved-rank log loss. Flag strength .5 selected on grid [0,.125,.25,.5,1]; Spy strength0 rejected. These are development selections, not unbiased validation.
provenance.control: Mirrored file objectives have separately fitted tables using identical training recipe. Control uses SAME Flag feature indices [0,1,2] and SAME real-selected strength .5; no independent control-strength selection.
provenance.bounds: Extra log factor clipped to +/-.75; resulting old+extra log likelihood clipped to +/-2. Unmoved and immobile ranks retain old factors. Exact public counts/masks preserved; 8-world importance estimate remains approximate.
provenance.interpretation: Conditional public geometry, not causal inverse planning. Real vs mirrored calibration intervals include zero; both outperform baseline descriptively.
limitations: DOS-specific training may not generalize to honest heads.
Own Flag and own Spy are legitimate private inputs. Enemy hidden nibbles and enemy setup are never features.
Only Flag features [0,1,2] active; Spy-only gamma0 rejection and all grid/control predictions preserved.
